landed_against.rule: R-17: this slice declares every diff path here and re-captures all three baselines in the same commit.

what_landed: A stacking innate's proc count is walked over the hits the fight landed (champions/armed_procs.py gains a hit-counter arm). Akshan, Ekko and Talon declare which streams stack; Ambessa uses the cast-stack arm Sylas already had. Every stack life and cap is read from the one cached sentence shape all four write.
why: Only Ekko's fight numbers move. His row was option-gated: proc_damage returns nothing at a zero count, and his default was zero, so Z-Drive Resonance priced nothing at all until a reader set p_procs. It is why he sat in the coverage sweep's OPTION_GATED table, and that row is now gone.

Akshan, Ambessa and Talon move one leaf each, the arming rule their slot now publishes: in the golden's five-second window the walk agrees with the count each module declared, which is the evidence that the declared defaults were reasonable readings of a short fight and wrong only as the fight grew.
